newsitem.title: USA: Thermadyne to sell Wear Resistance unit.
newsitem.headline: Thermadyne to sell Wear Resistance unit.

text.p: Thermadyne Holdings Corp said Wednesday is plans to sell its Wear Resistance business, which makes and sells wear resistance components and hard surfacing materials under the trade names Stellite and Deloro.
The operation being divested posted sales of $78.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, Thermadyne said.
The company said the sale will allow it to focus on the global cutting and welding market while improving its balance sheet.
Thermadyne makes cutting, welding and hard facing products. Its shares were up 5/8 Wednesday at 26-3/4.
